storeInfo.name: Dive Bar & Restaurant
storeInfo.tagline: Fresh Seafood, Cold Beer & Ocean Views in West Haven, CT

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Almejas al Estilo de la Costa
products.descriptionEs: Sopa espesa y cremosa tradicional de almejas, papas, cebolla y tocino ahumado.
products.descriptionEn: Rich and creamy traditional clam chowder loaded with tender clams, potatoes, and smoked bacon.

products.descriptionEs: Calamares ligeramente empanizados y fritos a la perfección, servidos con salsa marinara picante y limón.
products.descriptionEn: Lightly battered and golden-fried calamari served with zesty marinara sauce and fresh lemon.

products.descriptionEs: Alitas de pollo jugosas y crujientes bañadas en tu elección de salsa búfalo casera, BBQ o agridulce.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy and crispy chicken wings tossed in your choice of house-made buffalo, BBQ, or sweet chili sauce.

products.nameEs: Papas Fritas con Queso y Tocino
products.descriptionEs: Papas fritas sazonadas cubiertas con mezcla de quesos derretidos y trozos de tocino crujiente.
products.descriptionEn: Seasoned French fries topped with a rich blend of melted cheeses and crispy bacon bits.

products.descriptionEs: Generosa porción de carne de langosta fresca con un toque de mantequilla tibia o mayonesa ligera, en pan brioche tostado.
products.descriptionEn: Generous portion of fresh lobster meat tossed with warm butter or light mayo, served on a toasted brioche roll.

products.descriptionEs: Dos carnes de res jugosas, queso cheddar maduro, lechuga, tomate, cebolla caramelizada y salsa secreta en pan brioche.
products.descriptionEn: Two juicy beef patties, aged cheddar cheese, lettuce, tomato, caramelized onions, and secret sauce on a brioche bun.

products.descriptionEs: Filete de pescado fresco empanizado en cerveza, frito hasta quedar crujiente, servido con papas fritas, ensalada de repollo y tártara.
products.descriptionEn: Beer-battered fresh fish fillet fried to a golden crisp, served with french fries, coleslaw, and tartar sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Pechuga de pollo empanizada crujiente con pepinillos caseros, lechuga y mayonesa picante en pan artesanal.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy breaded chicken breast topped with house pickles, crisp lettuce, and spicy mayo on an artisan bun.
Shrimp, scallops, and fresh fish baked in a white wine garlic butter sauce, topped with seasoned breadcrumbs.
Three soft corn tortillas filled with crispy battered fish, purple cabbage, pico de gallo, and creamy chipotle sauce.
Slow-cooked tender pork ribs infused with craft beer, slathered in our signature smoky barbecue sauce.
Refreshing craft India Pale Ale on draft, brewed locally right here in Connecticut.
Our refreshing twist on the classic cocktail with a tropical fruit finish, perfect for ocean views.
All-natural house-made lemonade blended with fresh wild blackberry puree and fresh mint.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y alternativas sin gluten. Por favor, pregunte a nuestro personal por los platos disponibles.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian options and gluten-free alternatives. Please ask our staff for available dishes.

faqs.aEs: Aceptamos clientes sin reservación (walk-ins) y también tomamos reservaciones por teléfono.
faqs.aEn: We welcome walk-ins and also accept phone reservations.

faqs.aEs: Sí, tenemos estacionamiento conveniente disponible en el lote contiguo y espacio en la calle.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have convenient parking available in the adjacent lot as well as street parking.
